A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 22-page versions of SANA-Sprint. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–F support reliable comparison, with no material reading gaps.

before.justification: v3 reports original image-generation benchmarks, efficiency measurements, and ablations in Section 4, plus timestep/noise-distribution experiments and ControlNet examples in Appendix F.

after.justification: v4 retains the original benchmark results, efficiency measurements, ablations, and qualitative demonstrations in Section 4 and Appendix F.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithms 1–2 retain the same Flow-to-TrigFlow transformation, dense time embeddings, QK normalization, combined sCM/LADD objectives, max-time weighting, and ControlNet procedure.

E1.justification: Both retain the same training-data description, MJHQ-30K and GenEval evaluation, and HED/scribble-conditioned ControlNet scenarios. No dataset, task, or evaluated domain is added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 2 and Figure 4 preserve comparator membership within each step-count comparison, including FLUX-schnell, SDXL-DMD2, PCM, and SD3.5-Turbo. The pretrained-model comparison rows also match.

E3.justification: Table 2 and Appendix F retain the same model sizes, training budgets, metrics, 553 GenEval prompts, inference timesteps, and A100 BF16 timing protocol with batch sizes 10 for throughput and 1 for latency.

E4.justification: The schedule-transfer, normalization, embedding, CFG, loss-weighting, max-time, and noise-distribution ablations are unchanged. Appendix F also retains the same timestep searches and qualitative case studies.

E5.justification: Both retain point estimates and training curves without reporting repeated-run counts, evaluation seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The noise-distribution standard deviations remain training parameters rather than result uncertainty estimates.

E6.justification: Numerical entries, plotted findings, and qualitative samples match throughout. For example, Table 2 retains one-step SANA-Sprint 0.6B results of 7.04 FID, 28.04 CLIP, and 0.72 GenEval; appendix results are likewise unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, Proposition 3.1, and its Appendix D proof, including Equations 13–27, are unchanged. Replacing 'Appendix D' with 'Sec. D' only changes reference wording.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about hybrid distillation, unified 1–4-step generation, speed-quality performance, and real-time ControlNet interaction.

C2.justification: Both retain the same explanations of training stability, complementary sCM/LADD behavior, noise-distribution failure conditions, and applicability beyond SANA. No substantive interpretation or limitation is added or revised.

D1.justification: Appendices A–C and F.1 retain identical pseudocode, algorithms, hardware, hyperparameters, and training instructions. Code/model links and the stated open-source plans are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 5, Appendix E, and all 70 reference entries retain the same cited works and research positioning. No prior-work relationship or novelty claim changes.

P1.justification: v4 adds Dongyun Zou to the author list, updates the date/version stamp, and replaces several 'Appendix' references with 'Sec.' references. The substantive prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: v4 centers and reflows the first-page author/affiliation block and makes small spacing adjustments. All 11 figures and 8 tables retain their content, organization, and placement; embedded figure images are identical.

improvement.justification: v4 preserves the scientific argument and evidence, including Proposition 3.1, Table 2, and Appendix F. The authorship/date updates and minor presentation edits do not materially alter clarity, rigor, empirical support, or reproducibility.
